# goauth

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-auth"
```

Package goauth is the turnkey facade unifying bearer/cookie resolution, login, refresh, logout, and OAuth completion over the go\-auth subpackages.

```go
func (s *Service) Refresh(ctx context.Context, refreshToken string) (access, refresh string, err error)
```

Refresh validates a refresh token, reloads the user, enforces session max age and revalidation, and issues a new pair \(rotation\).

<a name="Service.Resolve"></a>
### func \(\*Service\) [Resolve](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/auth.go#L72>)

```go
func (s *Service) Resolve(ctx context.Context, bearer string) (*domain.Identity, error)
```

Resolve maps a bearer token to an Identity. Resolution order:

1. empty bearer \-\> ErrUnauthenticated
2. API token prefix \-\> API token
3. JWT access token
4. legacy flat\-file fallback
5. ErrUnauthenticated

# apitoken

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-auth/apitoken"
```

Package apitoken implements configurable\-prefix API token lifecycle \(dct\_, ghb\_\), SHA\-256 hashing, constant\-time validation, and at\-rest encryption via crypto.Sealer.

```go
const (
    // DefaultPrefix is the default API token prefix.
    DefaultPrefix = "dct_"
    // DefaultRandomBytes is the number of CSPRNG bytes in a generated token.

    // DisplayPrefixLength is the number of leading characters stored for
    // display.
    DisplayPrefixLength = 12
)
```

# crypto

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-auth/crypto"
```

Package crypto provides at\-rest encryption compatible with github.com/disaster37/raft/storage.Sealer and the AES\-256\-GCM envelopes used by dagger\-kubernetes and gohookbridge.

## Constants

<a name="DefaultHKDFInfo"></a>

```go
const (
    // DefaultHKDFInfo is the default domain-separation info string for
    // HKDF-SHA256 key derivation.
    DefaultHKDFInfo = "go-auth-at-rest-aes-256-gcm-v1"
    // MinSecretLength is the minimum input secret length (in bytes) for HKDF
    // derivation.
    MinSecretLength = 16
    // AES256KeySize is the required AES-256 key length in bytes.
    AES256KeySize = 32
)
```

## Variables

<a name="ErrSecretTooShort"></a>

```go
var (
    // ErrSecretTooShort is returned when an HKDF input secret is shorter than
    // MinSecretLength.
    ErrSecretTooShort = errors.New("crypto: secret must be at least 16 bytes")
    // ErrInvalidKeySize is returned when an AES key is not 32 bytes.
    ErrInvalidKeySize = errors.New("crypto: AES key must be 32 bytes")
    // ErrCiphertextShort is returned when a sealed value is too short to hold a
    // nonce.
    ErrCiphertextShort = errors.New("crypto: ciphertext too short")
)
```

<a name="DeriveKey"></a>
## func [DeriveKey](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/crypto/sealer.go#L52>)

```go
func DeriveKey(secret []byte, info string) ([32]byte, error)
```

DeriveKey derives a 32\-byte key from secret using RFC 5869 HKDF\-SHA256 with the given domain\-separation info string \(defaulting to DefaultHKDFInfo when empty\).

<a name="AESGCMSealer"></a>
## type [AESGCMSealer](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/crypto/sealer.go#L87-L90>)

AESGCMSealer implements Sealer using AES\-256\-GCM with optional AAD context. SealString emits the JSON envelope format; OpenString accepts both the JSON envelope and the raw base64\(nonce||ciphertext||tag\) format used by dagger\-kubernetes.

```go
type AESGCMSealer struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```


NewAESGCMSealer returns a sealer for a raw 32\-byte AES\-256 key.

```go
func NewDerivedSealer(secret []byte, info string, aad []byte) (*AESGCMSealer, error)
```

NewDerivedSealer derives a 32\-byte key from secret via HKDF\-SHA256 and returns a sealer using it.

<a name="Sealer"></a>
## type [Sealer](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/crypto/sealer.go#L44-L47>)

Sealer is the minimal interface for sealing/opening strings at rest. Any \*github.com/disaster37/raft/storage.AESGCMKeeper satisfies this interface directly without an adapter.

```go
type Sealer interface {
    SealString(plain string) (string, error)
    OpenString(stored string) (string, error)
}
```

<a name="ErrUnauthenticated"></a>Sentinel errors matched via errors.Is across all packages.

```go
var (
    ErrUnauthenticated        = errors.New("auth: unauthenticated")
    ErrInvalidCredential      = errors.New("auth: invalid credentials")
    ErrForbidden              = errors.New("auth: forbidden")
    ErrSessionRevoked         = errors.New("auth: session revoked")
    ErrOAuthCredentialExpired = errors.New("auth: oauth credential expired; re-authentication required")
    ErrOAuthNoCredential      = errors.New("auth: no stored oauth credential")
    ErrOAuthNotLeaderRefresh  = errors.New("auth: oauth refresh requires cluster leadership")
    ErrNotFound               = errors.New("auth: not found")
    ErrConflict               = errors.New("auth: resource already exists")
    ErrTokenExists            = errors.New("auth: api token already exists")
    ErrTokenNotRecoverable    = errors.New("auth: api token not recoverable")
    ErrValidation             = errors.New("auth: validation error")
    ErrRateLimited            = errors.New("auth: too many attempts; try again later")
    ErrIPBanned               = errors.New("auth: client IP is temporarily banned")
    ErrOriginNotAllowed       = errors.New("auth: origin not allowed")
    ErrNotLeader              = errors.New("auth: not the cluster leader")
)
```

<a name="User"></a>
## type [User](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/domain/user.go#L7-L23>)

User is a stored account. PasswordHash and OAuthTokenCiphertext are never serialized \(CWE\-532\).

```go
    ID                   string     `json:"id"`
    Username             string     `json:"username"`
    Role                 Role       `json:"role"`
    PasswordHash         string     `json:"-"`

}
```

<a name="DefaultAccessCookieName"></a>

```go
const (
    // DefaultAccessCookieName is the default access-token cookie name.
    DefaultAccessCookieName = "auth_access"
    // DefaultRefreshCookieName is the default refresh-token cookie name.
    DefaultRefreshCookieName = "auth_refresh"
    // DefaultSessionCookieName is the default session cookie name.
    DefaultSessionCookieName = "auth_session"
    // DefaultStateCookieName is the default OAuth state cookie name.
    DefaultStateCookieName = "oauth_state"
    // DefaultNonceCookieName is the default OIDC nonce cookie name.
    DefaultNonceCookieName = "oauth_nonce"
    // DefaultOAuthCookiePath is the default path scoping the OAuth state cookie.
    DefaultOAuthCookiePath = "/api/v1/auth/oauth"
    // DefaultStateMaxAge is the default OAuth state cookie max age in seconds.
    DefaultStateMaxAge = 600
)
```

<a name="SafeRedirectPath"></a>
## func [SafeRedirectPath](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/httpcookie/redirect.go#L8>)

```go
func SafeRedirectPath(redirect, defaultPath string) string
```

SafeRedirectPath validates a post\-login redirect target against CWE\-601. It rejects empty, non\-"/", "//", "/\\", "\\", CR/LF, and ASCII control characters, returning defaultPath \(or "/" when defaultPath is empty\).

# jwt

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-auth/jwt"
```

## Constants

<a name="TypeAccess"></a>

```go
const (
    // TypeAccess is the access-token typ claim.
    TypeAccess = "access"
    // TypeRefresh is the refresh-token typ claim.
    TypeRefresh = "refresh"
    // TypeOAuthState is the oauth-state-token typ claim.
    TypeOAuthState = "oauth_state"

    // DefaultAccessTTL is the default access-token lifetime.
    DefaultAccessTTL = 15 * time.Minute
    // DefaultRefreshTTL is the default refresh-token lifetime.
    DefaultRefreshTTL = 7 * 24 * time.Hour
    // DefaultOAuthStateTTL is the default oauth-state-token lifetime.
    DefaultOAuthStateTTL = 10 * time.Minute

    // MinSecretLength is the minimum accepted JWT secret length in bytes.
    MinSecretLength = 32
    // JWTHKDFInfo is the HKDF domain-separation info for JWT signing keys.
    JWTHKDFInfo = "go-auth.jwt.signing.v1"
    // SessionHKDFInfo is the HKDF domain-separation info for session signing
    // keys.
    SessionHKDFInfo = "go-auth.session.signing.v1"
)
```


ValidateSecret rejects weak session secrets \(CWE\-326\). An empty secret is allowed \(the caller auto\-generates one\); otherwise it must be at least MinSecretLength characters.

<a name="Claims"></a>
## type [Claims](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/jwt/jwt.go#L40-L52>)

Claims is the JWT body issued by the Service.

```go
type Claims struct {
    UserID       string   `json:"uid"`
    Username     string   `json:"username"`
    Role         string   `json:"role"`
    GroupIDs     []string `json:"groups,omitempty"`
    Type         string   `json:"typ"` // "access" | "refresh" | "oauth_state"
    Nonce        string   `json:"nonce,omitempty"`
    CodeVerifier string   `json:"cv,omitempty"` // PKCE code_verifier bound to oauth_state
    Provider     string   `json:"prv,omitempty"`
    TokenVersion int      `json:"token_version"`
    AuthEpoch    int64    `json:"auth_epoch,omitempty"`
    jwtv5.RegisteredClaims
}
```

```go
}
```

<a name="Service.IssueOAuthState"></a>
### func \(\*Service\) [IssueOAuthState](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/jwt/jwt.go#L153>)

```go
func (s *Service) IssueOAuthState(redirectPath, nonce, codeVerifier, provider string) (string, error)
```

IssueOAuthState issues a short\-lived state token for the OAuth flow. The redirect path is carried in the Username claim, the login\-CSRF nonce in the Nonce claim, the PKCE verifier in CodeVerifier, and the provider ID in Provider.


<a name="SessionToken"></a>
## type [SessionToken](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/jwt/session.go#L20-L33>)

SessionToken is the lightweight HMAC\-SHA256 session token \(gohookbridge compatible\). UserID/Issuer/Subject bind the session to a resolved principal; Username is display\-only and must never be used for authorization decisions.

```go
type SessionToken struct {
    UserID       string   `json:"user_id,omitempty"`
    Username     string   `json:"username,omitempty"`
    Role         string   `json:"role,omitempty"`
    Method       string   `json:"method"` // "internal" | "oidc"
    Provider     string   `json:"provider,omitempty"`
    Issuer       string   `json:"issuer,omitempty"`
    Subject      string   `json:"subject,omitempty"`
    ExpiresAt    int64    `json:"expires_at"`
    Groups       []string `json:"groups,omitempty"`
    SessionID    string   `json:"sid,omitempty"`
    TokenVersion int      `json:"token_version,omitempty"`
    AuthEpoch    int64    `json:"auth_epoch,omitempty"`
}
```

<a name="DecodeSession"></a>
### func [DecodeSession](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/jwt/session.go#L86>)

```go
func DecodeSession(tokenStr string, key [32]byte, now time.Time) (*SessionToken, error)
```

DecodeSession verifies and decodes a session token, rejecting tokens whose ExpiresAt is before now.

# oauth

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-auth/oauth"
```

Package oauth implements generic OIDC and GitHub OAuth2 providers, PKCE \(S256\), OIDC nonce, multi\-audience azp verification, email\_verified enforcement, userinfo merge, a 1 MiB response cap, cross\-origin redirect refusal, allowed\_endpoints validation, a regex GroupMapper, encrypted Credential storage, and a single\-flight Revalidator with leader\-only refresh.

<a name="DefaultDiscoveryTimeout"></a>

```go
const (
    // DefaultDiscoveryTimeout bounds OIDC provider discovery.
    DefaultDiscoveryTimeout = 15 * time.Second
    // DefaultHTTPTimeout is the default OAuth HTTP client timeout.
    DefaultHTTPTimeout = 15 * time.Second
    // MaxResponseBodyBytes caps provider responses (CWE-400).
    MaxResponseBodyBytes = 1 << 20 // 1 MiB
)
```

<a name="GroupMapper"></a>
## type [GroupMapper](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/oauth/mapper.go#L22-L24>)

GroupMapper maps upstream provider group names to local group names using an ordered list of regex rules. First\-match\-wins per group; a group matching no rule is dropped. Go regexp is RE2, so matching is linear\-time \(ReDoS\-safe\).

```go
type GroupMapper struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

```go
func (m *GroupMapper) Map(providerGroups []string) []string
```

Map applies the ordered rules to each provider group. First\-match\-wins per group; a group matching no rule is dropped. Output order is deterministic and duplicates are removed preserving first occurrence. With no rules it returns the input unchanged \(identity\).

Complete exchanges the code for tokens, verifies the ID token, extracts the sub/username/groups claims, enforces the allowlist, resolves the local user, and issues a JWT pair.

<a name="OIDCOAuthService.LoginURL"></a>
### func \(\*OIDCOAuthService\) [LoginURL](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/oauth/oidc.go#L264>)

```go
func (s *OIDCOAuthService) LoginURL(params AuthorizeParams) string
```

LoginURL returns the OIDC authorize URL. Discovery is bounded by DefaultDiscoveryTimeout; a discovery failure yields an empty URL.

<a name="OIDCOAuthService.Name"></a>
### func \(\*OIDCOAuthService\) [Name](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/oauth/oidc.go#L134>)

```go
func (s *OIDCOAuthService) Name() string
```

Name returns the provider ID.

<a name="OIDCOAuthService.Revalidate"></a>
### func \(\*OIDCOAuthService\) [Revalidate](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/oauth/oidc.go#L437>)

```go
func (s *OIDCOAuthService) Revalidate(ctx context.Context, u *domain.User) ([]string, error)
```

Revalidate re\-checks the user's current IdP group membership using the stored credential. It returns ErrOAuthCredentialExpired when the credential can no longer be used \(non\-destructive\), ErrOAuthNotLeaderRefresh on a follower, and ErrForbidden when membership no longer satisfies the allowlist.

```go
}
```

ChangePassword verifies the current password before setting a new one. The change bumps TokenVersion in the same persisted update so every outstanding JWT is revoked.

## Constants

<a name="DefaultMaxFailedAttempts"></a>

```go
const (
    // DefaultMaxFailedAttempts is the number of consecutive failures after
    // which lockouts start (CWE-307).
    DefaultMaxFailedAttempts = 5
    // DefaultBaseLockout is the first lockout duration once the threshold is
    // reached; it doubles with every further failure.
    DefaultBaseLockout = 30 * time.Second
    // DefaultMaxLockout caps the exponential lockout growth.
    DefaultMaxLockout = 15 * time.Minute
    // DefaultEntryTTL is how long an idle failure record is kept.
    DefaultEntryTTL = 30 * time.Minute
    // DefaultMaxEntries bounds the tracker map (CWE-770).
    DefaultMaxEntries = 4096
    // MaxLockoutShift caps the exponential shift so the duration computation
    // cannot overflow.
    MaxLockoutShift = 16
)
```

<a name="CheckMutationOrigin"></a>
## func [CheckMutationOrigin](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/headers.go#L50>)

```go
func CheckMutationOrigin(method, originHeader, refererHeader string, allowedOrigins []string) error
```

CheckMutationOrigin rejects cross\-origin mutating browser requests by validating the Origin \(falling back to the Referer origin\) against the allowed origins \(CWE\-352\). Requests without either header \(non\-browser clients\) pass through. An empty allowlist or "\*" allows any origin.

<a name="DefaultSecurityHeaders"></a>
## func [DefaultSecurityHeaders](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/headers.go#L14>)

```go
func DefaultSecurityHeaders(path string, isTLS bool) map[string]string
```

DefaultSecurityHeaders returns the browser hardening headers for a response \(CWE\-693\). Cache\-Control is set for API paths; HSTS is set only over TLS.

<a name="ExtractRealIP"></a>
## func [ExtractRealIP](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/realip.go#L69>)

```go
func ExtractRealIP(remoteAddr, xForwardedFor, xRealIP string, behindReverseProxy bool, trustedCIDRs []*net.IPNet) (net.IP, error)
```

ExtractRealIP extracts the client IP. Forwarded headers \(X\-Forwarded\-For, X\-Real\-IP\) are honored only when behindReverseProxy is enabled AND the direct peer is inside a trusted\-proxy CIDR. XFF is walked right\-to\-left, skipping trusted proxies, so a client cannot spoof its address by prepending an untrusted value \(CWE\-348\).

<a name="ExtractRequestOrigin"></a>
## func [ExtractRequestOrigin](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/headers.go#L32>)

```go
func ExtractRequestOrigin(originHeader, refererHeader string) string
```

ExtractRequestOrigin returns the request's Origin header, or the origin derived from the Referer header when Origin is absent.

<a name="FingerprintLogin"></a>
## func [FingerprintLogin](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/bantracker.go#L201>)

```go
func FingerprintLogin(username string) string
```

BanTracker counts unique credential failures per IP and bans suspicious clients \(credential stuffing\), while tolerating a single misconfigured client repeating the same credential.

```go
type BanTracker struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewBanTracker"></a>
### func [NewBanTracker](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/bantracker.go#L36>)

```go
func NewBanTracker(maxEntries int, clock func() time.Time) *BanTracker
```

NewBanTracker returns a BanTracker bounded to maxEntries IPs.

<a name="BanTracker.IsBanned"></a>
### func \(\*BanTracker\) [IsBanned](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/bantracker.go#L52>)

```go
func (bt *BanTracker) IsBanned(ip string) bool
```

IsBanned reports whether ip is currently banned.

<a name="BanTracker.ListBans"></a>
### func \(\*BanTracker\) [ListBans](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/bantracker.go#L116>)

```go

```

<a name="BanTracker.RecordAndBan"></a>
### func \(\*BanTracker\) [RecordAndBan](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/secguard/bantracker.go#L69>)

```go
func (bt *BanTracker) RecordAndBan(ip, fingerprint string, maxUniqueFailures int, banDuration, window time.Duration) bool
```

RecordAndBan records a credential failure for ip and bans it when the number of unique fingerprints within window reaches maxUniqueFailures. It returns true when the IP is banned as a result of this call.

```go
func (bt *BanTracker) Sweep(window time.Duration)
```

Sweep removes expired failure entries and expired bans.


# store

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-auth/store"
```

Package store defines the minimal persistence interfaces used by go\-auth and provides thread\-safe in\-memory reference implementations for tests and single\-node setups.

<a name="APITokenStore"></a>
## type [APITokenStore](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/store/store.go#L41-L47>)

APITokenStore persists API tokens.

```go
type APITokenStore interface {
    Upsert(ctx context.Context, t *domain.APIToken) error
    GetByHash(ctx context.Context, tokenHash string) (*domain.APIToken, error)
    GetByUser(ctx context.Context, userID string) (*domain.APIToken, error)
    Delete(ctx context.Context, userID string) error
    TouchLastUsed(ctx context.Context, id string, at time.Time) error
}
```

<a name="EpochStore"></a>

EpochStore tracks the cluster\-wide AuthEpoch for global session invalidation.

```go
type EpochStore interface {

}
```

```go
    RemoveMember(ctx context.Context, groupID, userID string) error
}
```

Package testutil provides deterministic test helpers: a fake clock and an in\-process mock OIDC server with RSA JWKS signing.

<a name="FreeListener"></a>
## func [FreeListener](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/testutil/clock.go#L40>)

```go
func FreeListener(t testing.TB) net.Listener
```

FreeListener returns a listener bound to an ephemeral loopback port. Tests must hand it to the server under test rather than probing\-then\-closing a port, which races with concurrent test binaries.

<a name="MockOIDCServer"></a>
## type [MockOIDCServer](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-auth/blob/main/testutil/oidcserver.go#L22-L56>)

MockOIDCServer is an in\-process OIDC provider signing RS256 ID tokens with a generated RSA key and serving discovery, JWKS, token, and userinfo endpoints.

```go
type MockOIDCServer struct {
    Server *httptest.Server

    // Configurable identity claims.
    ClientID      string
    Subject       string
    Username      string
    Email         string
    EmailVerified bool
    Groups        []string
    Nonce         string
    Audience      []string
    AZP           string

    // Behavior overrides.
    TokenStatus       int
    UserinfoStatus    int
    UserinfoFailOnce  bool
    OversizedBody     bool
    OmitIDToken       bool
    OmitEmailVerified bool
    AccessToken       string
    RefreshToken      string

    // ExtraUserinfoClaims are merged into the userinfo response only.
    ExtraUserinfoClaims map[string]any

    // Counters.
    TokenRequests    int
    UserinfoRequests int
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="NewMockOIDCServer"></a>
